gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-andada-pro: Andada Pro is a classic serif with gently varied strokes and open counters. Andada Pro sits beneath Bruno Ace like a thin-stroked counterweight, softening a heading drawn in ruler-straight, wire-thick lines.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-aref-ruqaa: Distinctive Bruno Ace keeps diagonals as stout as uprights, while Aref Ruqaa bends each curve with a hint of pen pressure. Open bowls give the body a friendly, welcoming pull.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-aref-ruqaa-ink: Aref Ruqaa Ink is a text serif, literary and open throughout. Aref Ruqaa Ink adds mild contrast beneath Bruno Ace, whose pen line holds one width from start to finish.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-average: Literary Average swells its curves slightly, like a reed pen, giving a serif body real softness. Yet below Bruno Ace, with its unit-width stroke, paragraphs of Average would feel unhurried and gently shaded.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-besley: Dignified Besley holds its rounds open and thins its crossbars slightly against the stems, a serif with editorial poise. Bruno Ace is built to announce; Besley is built to be read.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-biz-udpmincho: A single-width rolling-ball line defines Bruno Ace from end to end. BIZ UDPMincho, a classic serif with mild thicks and gaps that keep letters apart, makes paragraphs feel refined and traditional.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-bona-nova: Diagonals as thick as horizontals mark Bruno Ace at once. Bona Nova, a serif with restrained swell, holds its mouths open, and thinnest points still carry real weight through a long run of text.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-bona-nova-sc: Stout and ruler-straight, Bruno Ace holds one weight along every curve. Bona Nova SC, a serif with gentle modulation and no sharp hairlines, makes extended reading feel refined and unclogged.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-brawler: Literary and refined, Brawler is a text serif with gently varied strokes. Brawler reads smoothly through paragraphs, far from Bruno Ace, whose heading is a rope-thin outline of uniform weight.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-brygada-1918: Dignified Brygada 1918 pairs sturdy thin lines with slightly heavier thicks, while Bruno Ace draws its lowercase a without hairlines. Paragraphs in it feel warm, worn-in and quietly traditional.
